name: smwmusic-chromag-sledgehammer
title: Chromag - Sledgehammer #2
description:
This is one of the ports I made for Entropy
There are 2 versions, one specifically made for titles and credits which has a higher quality but isn't compatible with a lot of stuff (only for OWs and most titles / credits).
You can switch between the versions with:
set define to #define Version 0, to get the higher quality Title/Credits/OW version
Set define to #define Version 1, to get the lower quality version
the lower quality version isn't compatible with:
P-Switch, Yoshi Mount, Bonus End, Thunder
